title: fix(rest): a refused json export answers the 400 envelope, not a truncated 200 stream
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DM77tsfTXyZb3uxqJzawYo9)_

domain:server#3 · os-elon-musk · session_016WV4d1cSb5LKsNDntVL6VG

Fixes #27682

## What changes

- `packages/rest/src/data-action-routes.ts`: the json export writes its opening `[` after the first `findData` answers, not before it. One line moved into the read loop (`if (format === 'json' && firstChunk) res.write('[')`), placed before the zero-row break so an empty export is still `[]`. Nothing else in the route changes, and the import-job region (#27711) is untouched.
- `packages/rest/src/export-json-refusal-envelope.test.ts` (new): pins both halves through the real `HonoHttpServer`.
- `.changeset/27682-json-export-read-first.md`: patch for `@objectstack/rest`.

## Why

The first `res.write` commits the Hono adapter to a streaming 200. Writing `[` before the first read meant a query that read refused reached the client as a 200 whose body was a lone `[`, while `format=csv` answered the 400 envelope. Triage 6504427279: the json export reads its first page before it writes any byte and answers the same envelope. A refusal on a later page is not widened here.

## Verification

- Pin, over a real `SqlDriver` (SQLite): `?search=x&searchFields=nope` (the card's repro, `400 INVALID_FIELD`) and `?search=x&searchFields=,` (`400 VALIDATION_ERROR`) answer the same status and body for `format=json` as for `format=csv`. Ablation: with the early write restored, both json rows are red (200); restored, green.
- Byte identity: a successful json export over one page, three pages (`page=50`, 120 rows) and zero rows answers exactly `[` + rows joined by `,` + `]` (or `[]`), `Content-Type: application/json; charset=utf-8`, with the same number of reads. Green on the unfixed code too, so the success path did not move.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 59 derived families, 58 run green, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, exit 3, needs a whole-tree build). `pnpm lint` green; `@objectstack/rest` typecheck and full suite green (343 files, 6702 passed) after merging `main`.

Out of scope finding: `format=xlsx` has the same early commit. Its workbook writer is created before the first read, and the card's repro answers 200 there too (measured). Not fixed or pinned here; the seat can file it.
